finding: A case switch during the awaited Turnstile challenge could still dispatch a transfer operation before the existing post-response generation check.
reachability: Confirmed through the real #case-new button while the local verification mock was pending; no synthetic casechange event was used.

before.result: Failed as expected at the create request-count assertion: expected 0, received 1.
reproduction: Select a saved synthetic case and start encrypted transfer creation.
Hold the mocked challenge callback pending.
Click Create another case through the real UI.
The original code sent one create POST, then noticed the case change only after the response.
before.boundary: The first create assertion stopped the pre-fix run; no separate pre-fix lookup execution is claimed. Both operations shared the same affected helper.

references.change: Require an isCurrent callback in transferRequest.
After token resolution, reject stale generation before creating the request timeout or calling fetch.
Creation supplies its captured case-generation comparison.
Lookup supplies its captured case-generation comparison.

fix.behavior: A canceled challenge completion shows transfer.caseChanged, releases pending controls, creates no orphan ciphertext and consumes no lookup. Existing guards still discard responses when a case changes after dispatch.

coverage: Explicit fresh creation retry sends one POST and produces a private link.
Canceled lookup sends zero POSTs and opens no restore preview.
Explicit fresh lookup retry dispatches normally and handles the mocked 404.
Private output is cleared on case switch; controls are re-enabled.
The original saved synthetic case remains intact.
after.mode: Always mocked challenge and transfer APIs, including if QA_LIVE_TRANSFERS is enabled for the separate live test.

after.command: QA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4321 npx playwright test tests/browser/transfer.spec.ts --grep 'case changes clear|short ID alone' --reporter=list --output=.cache/review-transfer-existing
coverage: Already-dispatched responses cannot display another case's private output or restore preview.
Short IDs need a key; three mocked lookups remain bounded.
429, 403 and 503 retain the local case and re-enable controls.

additional_parent_evidence.checks: Parent reported lint/check/build passed and four local built transfer tests passed, including the delayed-challenge test and two-context mocked crypto round trip.
additional_parent_evidence.boundary: This record does not claim public deployment completion or a fresh real-Turnstile round trip.

boundaries: This fix used local mocks only; no production transfer, quota consumption or database mutation was performed by the reviewer.
No server or production verification bypass was added.
Operations already dispatched before a later case switch cannot be recalled; existing response guards prevent unexpected UI/restore effects.
No source change was made after the parent's source freeze; the parent owns build, deployment and public checks.

release_followup.note: This follow-up records final release verification; the original source/baseline observations above retain their original provenance.
